title: Pals Rewards Points Earned on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
Each charged line of a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase earns Pals Rewards points on its amount billed, at the member's base earn rate times the method's points multiplier. Fees never earn.

When a line is cancelled, refunded or credited, the points it earned are reversed in proportion.

| Fulfillment method | Points multiplier on order merchandise |
|---|---|
| Standard Ship-to-Home | 1 |
| Expedited Ship-to-Home | 1 |
| Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 1 |
| Curbside Pickup | 1 |
| Same-Day Delivery | 1 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 1 |

### Points of judgement

- **What earns:** the amount billed on each line charge, that is, after its allocated coupon and certificate.
- **What never earns:** fulfillment, delivery, freight and redelivery fees.
- **Multiplier:** every method multiplies the base earn rate by 1, so a line earns at the member's base rate.

### Examples (hypothetical figures)

- A line billed at a hypothetical $40.00, for a member whose base earn rate is a hypothetical 1 point per dollar, earns 40 points (40 times 1 times the multiplier of 1).
- If that whole line is later cancelled, the 40 points it earned are reversed.
- A hypothetical $9.99 delivery fee on the same order earns nothing.
